planNote: Verify all four witnesses with core geometric and visual checks, run full suite and PRT checks, and probe contested/timing-dependent claims for Witnesses A and B with speed and time sensitivity sweeps.

tasks.why: Independently verify the baseline run_checks.mjs suite on a clean sandbox.
Confirm the perception-reaction time available to the colliding drivers matches the 10.43 s sight distance finding.
Verify Witness A has an unblocked line of sight to Vehicle A at t=4.5s and check when the trailer blocks it.
Confirm Witness A's visibility verdict is robust to position perturbations inside the pickup cab.
Check that Vehicle A lies comfortably within Witness A's central field of view at t=4.5s.
Test when the turning trailer begins to block Witness A's view of the eastbound car around t=4.5s.
Verify whether the tractor blocks Witness B's view of Vehicle A right before impact at t=9.8s.
Determine how far Witness B would need to shift from her marked position to flip the partial occlusion verdict.
Evaluate Witness B's peripheral 31.5-degree gaze angle toward Vehicle A and test alternative gaze targets.
Test whether varying Vehicle A's approach speed clears the tractor blockage for Witness B.
Test whether shifting Witness B's observation time by +-2s around t=9.8s provides an unobstructed view.
Confirm Witness C's unobstructed sightline to the trailer across the eastbound lanes at impact.
Verify that Witness C's clear view from the westbound inside lane holds across position perturbations.
Confirm the trailer is near the center of Witness C's gaze at t=10.43s.
Confirm that the storefront cooler and window posters block Witness D's view of the highway at impact.
Verify that Witness D remains completely blocked by storefront obstructions across surrounding counter positions.
Verify Witness D's gaze alignment toward the crash direction behind the storefront occluder.
Generate an overhead scene render to verify overall vehicle placements, geometry, and trajectories.
Render Witness A's perspective to confirm no self-occlusion from his pickup cab and clear visibility of Vehicle A.
Render Witness B's perspective to confirm pixel-level occlusion of Vehicle A by the tractor.
Render Witness C's perspective to visually confirm his view of the trailer at impact.
Render Witness D's perspective to visually confirm full blockage by the storefront cooler and posters.
